ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: What is at the top of the food chain?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a food chain/food web schematic. At the bottom there are Mojave Yucca, Cactus, Shrub; in the middle there are Jackrabbit, Cottontail, Chuckwalla; above there are Coyote and Rattlesnake; at the very top Cheetah is labeled alone. Multiple arrows point from organisms at lower levels to consumers at higher levels, and finally there is an arrow pointing to the topmost Cheetah. Reasoning: The question asks what is at the top of the food chain. According to the convention in food chain diagrams that arrows point from food to predator, the organism located at the highest position and receiving arrows is the top predator. Therefore, the top of the food chain is cheetah.
